rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for the hair above the eye.

example.english: They hit their forehead, and even their eyebrow swelled up.
example.traditional: 佢撞親個額頭，連眼眉都腫埋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zong6 can1 go3 ngaak6 tau4 lin4 ngaan5 mei4 dou1 zung2 maai4

rows.note: Use this straightforward noun as an alternative to the more colloquial 眼眉.

example.english: The beautician said one eyebrow is higher than the other.
example.traditional: 美容師話我一邊眉毛高啲。
example.jyutping: mei5 jung4 si1 waa6 ngo5 jat1 bin1 mei4 mou4 gou1 di1
